first_name.description: Patient first name (letters, hyphens, spaces only, 1-50 chars).

last_name.description: Patient last name (letters, hyphens, spaces only, 1-50 chars).

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in MM/DD/YYYY format. Must not be in the future.

state.description: 2-letter U.S. state abbreviation (e.g. CA, NY, TX).

email.description: Optional email address. Omit or pass null if not provided.

address_line_2.description: Optional apartment, suite, or unit number. Omit or pass null if not provided.

insurance_provider.description: Optional name of insurance carrier. Omit or pass null if not provided.

insurance_member_id.description: Optional insurance member ID. Omit or pass null if not provided.

preferred_language.description: Optional preferred language, defaults to English if not provided.

emergency_contact_name.description: Optional emergency contact full name. Omit or pass null if not provided.

emergency_contact_phone.description: Optional 10-digit emergency contact phone number. Omit or pass null if not provided.
